stories.title: Vijayawada municipal corporation turns plastic waste into benches
stories.summary: The Vijayawada Municipal Corporation is converting single-use plastic waste into products to curb pollution. Additional Commissioner Dr D Chandrasekhar released a poster to promote eco-friendly goods and inaugurated a bench made from recycled plastic. The city is currently attempting to demonstrate the utility of discarded materials.

stories.title: Vijayawada recycles 13,000 kg of plastic into public benches
stories.summary: The Vijayawada Municipal Corporation has recycled 13,000 kg of single-use plastic to manufacture 150 public benches. Each bench weighs 90 kg. The initiative aims to encourage public participation and demonstrate how discarded plastic can be converted into resources in association with the Prajapragathi Trust.

stories.title: Global plastic packaging market projected to reach $668.9 billion by 2034
stories.summary: The global plastic packaging market was valued at $428.6 billion in 2025. Prismane Consulting projects the industry will grow at a compound annual growth rate of 5.1 percent through 2034. The report cites the material's versatility and lightweight properties as primary drivers for continued supply chain integration.

stories.title: Produce packaging market projected to reach $39.83 billion
stories.summary: The produce packaging industry is projected to increase from $37.28 billion in 2025 to $39.83 billion. The sector is adapting to new sustainability standards and increasing trade volumes, according to market data. The industry continues to experience growth driven by evolving consumer demands and technological advancements.

stories.title: Society of Plastics Engineers honors automotive innovations
stories.summary: The Society of Plastics Engineers Automotive Division recognized three innovations for 2026 and 2027 model-year vehicles. The awards highlighted a thermoplastic door seal, a composite tunnel reinforcement, and an advanced coolant seal. Plastics are increasingly being used to replace metal in top safety solutions.

stories.title: Plastic spice jars market enters 2026 with diversified supply
stories.summary: The global plastic spice jars market is a mature category defined by rigid containers made from PET, PP, PS, or HDPE. According to an IndexBox report, the market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture to meet steady pantry replenishment cycles.

stories.title: Bengaluru officials fine stalls for single-use plastic violations
stories.summary: Municipal officials imposed a total fine of 4,000 rupees on stalls at the Krishi Mela 2026 in Bengaluru. The surprise inspections targeted vendors using banned single-use plastics during the three-day agricultural fair. Organisers were directed to ensure the event remains zero-waste.

stories.title: Oil price volatility impacts polyester production costs
stories.summary: Fashion industry reliance on virgin polyester is facing higher costs as oil prices rise. Brent crude averaged $124 a barrel in October, the highest level since 2022. Conflict in the Middle East and shipping disruptions have exposed the vulnerability of a business model built on cheap synthetic fibers.

stories.title: Recycled plastics market sees growth driven by technology
stories.summary: The market for recycled plastics is expanding as companies and governments prioritize sustainability. Advances in recycling technologies are cited as primary factors propelling this momentum. The sector is currently exploring new product segments and emerging trends to meet the rising demand for recycled materials through 2030.

stories.title: Plastic fuel tanks market projected to expand through 2035
stories.summary: The global plastic fuel tanks market is expected to grow through 2035, supported by automotive lightweighting trends and aftermarket demand. Primarily made from HDPE and XLPE, these tanks offer corrosion resistance and design flexibility. The market currently benefits from the resilience of internal combustion engine vehicle fleets.

stories.title: Polyethylene lamination films market grows at 6.2 percent CAGR
stories.summary: The polyethylene lamination films market increased from $1.45 billion in 2025. The sector is expected to grow at a 6.2 percent compound annual growth rate until 2030, driven by advances in packaging technology and evolving consumer behavior regarding flexible and protective packaging solutions.

stories.title: LDPE packaging market projected to grow at 6.8 percent CAGR
stories.summary: The low-density polyethylene packaging market is expected to grow at a 6.8 percent compound annual growth rate until 2030. The Business Research Company reports that the segment is gaining attention due to its efficiency and versatility in meeting changing consumer preferences and evolving market demands.

stories.title: Tough photopolymer resin market for SLA grows
stories.summary: The global market for tough photopolymer resin used in stereolithography is characterized by materials engineered for high tensile strength and durability. According to IndexBox, the market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a regionally diversified supply architecture for functional prototyping in automotive and medical sectors.

stories.title: Washington fines 38 producers for missing recycled content targets
stories.summary: Washington state has issued combined penalties of $246,548 to 38 producers. The fines follow an enforcement action regarding state mandates for the use of post-consumer recycled content in plastic packaging. The state is actively monitoring compliance with its established recycled-content targets.

stories.title: WM to Supply PureCycle Millions of Pounds of Recycled PP - PlasticsToday
NEPRA raises ₹110 crore to expand recycling capacity
stories.summary: Waste management startup NEPRA has raised ₹110 crore from the Private Infrastructure Development Group to build new material recovery facilities. The company plans to more than double its daily waste processing capacity from 900 tonnes to 1,880 tonnes. The capital will also support working capital requirements.

stories.title: Washington fines 38 plastic producers for recycling failures
stories.summary: The Washington Department of Ecology fined 38 plastic producers a combined $246,548 for failing to meet state-mandated recycled content requirements in 2025. The law requires minimum postconsumer recycled content in beverage containers and plastic bags. The department identifies non-compliant firms through mandatory annual reports.

stories.title: PureCycle, WM strike feedstock agreement
stories.summary: PureCycle Technologies and WM have signed a multiyear agreement to supply nearly 25 million pounds of polypropylene bales annually. The deal connects WM’s collection infrastructure with PureCycle’s resin production. PureCycle claims the partnership will bring more recycled material into the market as new packaging.

stories.title: Recove Ventures raises ₹56.25 crore
stories.summary: Circular economy startup Recove Ventures has raised ₹56.25 crore in a funding round consisting of equity and debt. The company plans to deploy the capital to build infrastructure in Maharashtra and expand its footprint in Karnataka. Existing backers and new investors participated in the round.

stories.title: Packaging EPR laws change the due diligence playbook
stories.summary: Extended producer responsibility laws are increasingly impacting corporate deals. Producers must now register and report packaging use, with non-compliance risking market access. Buyers are now treating these obligations as a significant factor in valuation, moving beyond simple environmental footnotes to direct financial impact on deals.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu releases warehousing and circular-economy policies
stories.summary: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin released the Tamil Nadu Warehousing Policy 2026 and the Circular Economy Investment Policy 2026. The warehousing policy offers a 25 percent capital subsidy and land cost concessions for projects in specific districts. The initiatives aim to strengthen logistics and modern infrastructure across the state.

stories.title: FSSAI proposes eco-friendly packaging for pan masala
stories.summary: The FSSAI has issued a draft notification to amend packaging regulations for pan masala. The proposal seeks to include naturally derived materials like paper and cellulose as suggestive options. The agency states these materials are recognized for their suitability in food packaging and evolving industry practices.

stories.title: Nigeria introduces plastic waste control regulations
stories.summary: The National Environmental Plastic Waste Control Regulations 2026 require producers and importers to register with a producer responsibility organization. The rules place new obligations on brand owners and converters. In a market where packaging often dictates product affordability, the regulations aim to formalize the plastic waste bargain.

stories.title: Lessons from Washington’s PCR law, 3 years into enforcement - Packaging Dive
Ghana’s plastic waste remains largely untapped
stories.summary: Ghana generates approximately one million tonnes of plastic waste annually. Despite the potential for a lucrative industrial market, weak recycling systems and delayed producer-responsibility legislation have left the sector largely underdeveloped. Much of the country’s plastic waste currently remains in drains.

stories.title: Packaging industry warns regulatory uncertainty slows innovation
stories.summary: Industry leaders including Constantia Flexibles and LyondellBasell warn that fragmented regulations are complicating investment and redesign efforts. Experts argue that current requirements must better balance circularity goals with affordability and manufacturing efficiency. They are calling for clearer, harmonized rules to reduce compliance burdens and support environmental outcomes.

stories.title: Clean Recycle launches PPWR compliance platform
stories.summary: Clean Recycle has launched a digital platform to assist companies with European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation compliance. The tool helps firms assess packaging design, material composition, and recyclability. The launch follows increasingly stringent requirements for manufacturers and importers placing packaging on the European market.

stories.title: Fyffes overhauls banana and pineapple packaging to cut plastic usage - Packaging Gateway
ITC shifts focus to sustainable packaging materials
stories.summary: ITC is intensifying its focus on sustainable packaging through the development of proprietary coatings on paperboard. The company aims to replace plastic components, such as coffee lids and pods, with moulded fibre products. The chairman stated the company is moving toward sustainable alternatives for its packaging portfolio.

stories.title: Paper and paperboard packaging market projected to hit $546.52 billion by 2030
stories.summary: The paper and paperboard packaging market is projected to reach $546.52 billion by 2030. The sector cites evolving consumer preferences and expanding industries as primary drivers for this growth. As environmental concerns intensify, the industry is positioning itself for ongoing expansion in the coming years.

stories.title: Fyffes tests plastic-reduction systems for fruit supply chains
stories.summary: Fyffes is developing packaging to reduce plastic use across its banana and pineapple supply chains. One initiative uses 46 percent less plastic per container, saving approximately 16 kg of material per unit. The company is also exploring recycled polypack options while maintaining fruit freshness and protection.

stories.title: Fyffes expands packaging innovation portfolio
stories.summary: Fyffes is advancing a portfolio of packaging innovations to reduce plastic use and support circularity in its banana and pineapple supply chains. The program ranges from market-ready solutions to long-term concepts, focusing on recycled content and alternative materials while maintaining food safety and fruit quality standards.

stories.title: Paper tray box market enters 2026 with new demand fundamentals
stories.summary: The global paper tray box market enters 2026 with disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The sector is driven by a global pivot away from plastic, stringent regulatory frameworks, and the continued growth of e-commerce and sustainable packaging solutions.

stories.title: Life Water debuts paper bottle developed with Pulpex
stories.summary: Life Water has launched a 500ml paper water bottle developed with Pulpex. Using molded fiber technology, the bottle transforms wood fiber into a functional container. The company says the format is designed to reduce carbon impact and be recycled through existing paper and cardboard recycling streams.

stories.title: Italian waste paper exports rise 13 percent
stories.summary: Italian waste paper exports reached nearly 950,000 tonnes in the first half of 2026, a 13 percent increase over the previous year. Almost half of the volume was shipped to India. Businesses in the sector report feeling the strain of high energy and transport costs.

stories.title: John Taylor named president of Georgia-Pacific Corrugated Packaging
stories.summary: Georgia-Pacific has named John Taylor president of its Corrugated Packaging business, effective immediately. Taylor will oversee operations across 32 sites, including box plants and digital print facilities. He succeeds Keith Hamilton, who is leaving the company for a senior leadership role elsewhere.

stories.title: Siegwerk introduces water-based ink technology in India
stories.summary: Siegwerk has launched its AQUAGEN water-based ink technology in the Indian market. The company is targeting the label and narrow web sector, aiming to provide innovations for converters. The launch comes as the industry seeks new developments in printing technologies for flexible packaging and labels.

stories.title: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries celebrates 70 years of paper converting machinery
stories.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Machinery Systems marked the 70th anniversary of its paper converting division in Tokyo. Since 1956, the company has delivered more than 300 corrugating machines and over 700 box-making machines. The event celebrated seven decades of manufacturing equipment for the corrugated board industry.

stories.title: Source One Packaging installs Omet XFlex X6 - Labels & Labeling
Maxcess increases investment in Indian converting market
stories.summary: Maxcess International is deepening its investment in India, citing the competitive edge of local equipment makers. The US-based company, which has operated in India for 25 years, showcased its portfolio at Loupe India 2026. The firm described the exhibition as its strongest showing in two decades.

stories.title: Acme Rolltech debuts upgraded anilox technology
stories.summary: Acme Rolltech introduced two upgraded anilox technologies at Loupe India 2026, targeting demand for premium labels and flexible packaging. The company reported interest from converters moving from gravure to flexographic printing. Visitors from the gravure segment were noted as a primary source of new prospects.

stories.title: APM launches AP500 sack-filling machine
stories.summary: APM has launched the AP500, an auger-fed sack-filling machine for food ingredients. The system fills 25kg sacks at a rate of 4-6 units per minute with 0.5 to 1 percent weight accuracy. It is designed for food-production environments and can operate as a standalone or semi-automatic system.

stories.title: Moksha reports flexo press installations
stories.summary: Moksha Label Printing showcased a 6-color, 4-servo flexographic press at Loupe India 2026, capable of processing substrates from 12-micron films to 300 GSM paperboard. The company reported nine deliveries through October 2026, with 13 additional machines in its order book for the current financial year.

stories.title: Ixapack Global introduces robotic case packer
stories.summary: Ixapack Global has released a case packer featuring delta robots for high-speed pick-and-place operations. The machine includes tool-free format changes and an optimized case-closing system. It is designed to reach speeds of up to 25 cases per minute.

stories.title: Independent cart technology offers packaging flexibility
stories.summary: Independent cart technology is replacing traditional belts and chains in packaging machines. By allowing machines to adapt to different product formats without mechanical adjustments, the technology aims to reduce the need for additional equipment. The approach is being adopted to improve flexibility in automated production lines.

stories.title: QIYU PACK Launches Custom Botanical Packaging Bags Solution for Enhanced Product Protection and Global Brand Visibility
Smithers forecasts e-commerce packaging market to reach $105.2 billion
stories.summary: Smithers forecasts the global e-commerce packaging market will reach $105.2 billion by 2031. The report highlights how automation and AI-enabled inventory systems are driving demand for machine-readable packaging. Right-sizing technologies have reportedly reduced cubic shipment volumes by 30 to 40 percent for some retailers.

stories.title: Taurus Packaging receives award for recyclable sleeve
stories.summary: Taurus Packaging earned an Honorable Mention at the AWA International Sleeve Label Awards for its Trucycl mono-PET shrink sleeve. The company claims the product is 100 percent recyclable and compatible with existing application infrastructure. It was developed for Colgate MaxFresh mouthwash in collaboration with Colgate-Palmolive India.

stories.title: E-commerce packaging market projected to reach $360.6 billion
stories.summary: The global e-commerce packaging sector is projected to reach $360.6 billion by 2033, according to Persistence Market Research. The market is expected to grow at a compound annual rate of 16.8 percent from 2026, driven by rising online retail volumes and cross-border delivery demands.

stories.title: Coffee capsule buyers prioritize recyclability
stories.summary: Research from Amcor indicates that 64 percent of coffee capsule consumers consider recyclability when making purchases. For 34 percent of those surveyed, it is a primary factor in their decision. The findings suggest that sustainability is now a significant influence on consumer choice in the coffee market.

stories.title: Sustainable packaged goods grow faster than conventional products
stories.summary: Sustainably marketed consumer packaged goods have grown 4.9 times faster than conventional products since 2013, according to data from the NYU Stern Center for Sustainable Business and Circana. These products accounted for nearly 45 percent of all market growth despite representing only a quarter of the market.

stories.title: Target links food growth to packaging
stories.summary: At the PLMA trade show, Target’s food chief identified packaging as a primary driver for the company’s growth. The retailer is focusing on how product presentation influences consumer purchasing decisions in the food category.

stories.title: PwC suggests FMCG brands focus on health-conscious consumers
stories.summary: PwC’s Ravi Kapoor advised FMCG companies to rethink pricing and product formulations to better serve health-conscious consumers amid rising inflation. Kapoor noted that scaling nutritious food in smaller markets requires efficient supply chains and cost management to meet shifting consumer demands.

stories.title: Confectionery brands consider paper packaging for quality perception
stories.summary: Sappi’s white paper suggests that consumers associate paper packaging with higher product quality. Research from the University of Melbourne indicates that the physical experience of packaging, including texture and finish, influences consumer expectations before they taste the product. The wrapper is now a marketing tool.

stories.title: Brookfield nears $1.7-billion deal to buy packaging firm PGP Glass from Blackstone - Moneycontrol.com
Amcor considers $5.2 million expansion for Indian Trail plant
stories.summary: Amcor Rigid is weighing a $5.2 million investment to modernize its Indian Trail facility. Local officials approved a tax incentive to help the town compete for the project against sites in Ohio and Indiana. The company has not yet finalized the decision.

stories.title: Label Apeel targets 30 percent growth after funding
stories.summary: Label Apeel secured a seven-figure funding package from Lloyds to expand into high-end carton packaging. The family-run business, which specializes in decorative labels, is investing in digital printing and converting technology to support its growth targets. The garage-founded firm is now in its third generation.

stories.title: Forum Packaging profits rise despite cost pressures
stories.summary: Lincolnshire-based Forum Packaging reported a 38 percent increase in pre-tax profits to £2.17 million for the year ended 30 April 2026. The company achieved this despite warning of rising energy and raw material costs. Turnover grew by 2.7 percent to £16.3 million.

stories.title: LEAP India acquires two packaging businesses
stories.summary: LEAP India is acquiring Vimprotech and Total International Packaging Solutions for a combined ₹142 crore. The move shifts the pallet-pooling platform toward becoming an integrated returnable packaging provider. The transactions are expected to close by the third quarter of the 2026-27 fiscal year.

stories.title: DCGpac revenue grows 35 percent in FY26
stories.summary: Delhi-based DCGpac reported a 34.6 percent increase in revenue to Rs 208.5 crore for the financial year ended March 2026. The company remains EBITDA positive, citing rising demand for customized and sustainable packaging solutions from e-commerce and D2C brands.

stories.title: Recove Ventures raises Rs 56 crore for recycling
stories.summary: Plastic recycling startup Recove Ventures has raised Rs 56.25 crore in equity and debt to expand operations in Maharashtra and Karnataka. Investors in the round include Samara Capital founder Sumeet Narang and Capri Global. The company focuses on expanding its plastic recycling infrastructure.

stories.title: TCPL Packaging forms Singapore joint venture with Brandart
stories.summary: TCPL Packaging has entered a joint venture with Italy-based Brandart to explore packaging opportunities in the Asia-Pacific region. The partnership will operate through a new company incorporated in Singapore, combining TCPL’s manufacturing with Brandart’s experience in high-end retail and visual merchandising.

stories.title: Packaging manufacturers shift toward premium and sustainable products
stories.summary: Packaging manufacturers are increasingly moving beyond basic volume-based production to offer innovative dispensing and recyclable materials. Companies are responding to consumer brands seeking better product presentation and global relationships. Recent quarterly performance reports suggest this shift is creating new growth opportunities across international markets.
